name: motif_count
author: 51616f3b
description: Counts 3-node subgraph motifs. For undirected graphs, it counts closed triangles (3-cliques), open wedges (2-hop paths lacking closure), and transitivity. For directed graphs, it computes the full 16-type Batagelj-Mrvar triad census, induced and non-induced feed-forward loops (030T and generalized FFLs), 3-cycles (030C and cycle instances), and mutual dyads. Distinguishes strictly induced motifs from non-induced motif instances. Edge weights and self-loops are ignored. Result graph ID is always null.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.
